content: Gradio gr.Blocks layout (current version 6.19.0): gr.File(label=..., file_types=[...], file_count='single', type='filepath') passes a str path to handlers. gr.Radio(choices=[...], value=...) for toggle. gr.HTML(value='') accepts and returns plain HTML strings. gr.Textbox(lines=N, interactive=False, placeholder=..., show_copy_button=True) for read-only output. gr.Button(value='...', variant='primary') with .click(fn=handler, inputs=[...], outputs=[...]). gr.Blocks(theme=gr.themes.Soft(), title='...'). Handlers return tuples matching outputs list. Multiple outputs supported. Event chaining: .click().then() for sequential updates. gr.update(interactive=False, value='Processing...') to change button state during processing. Sync handlers run in thread pools; async def handlers bypass threadpool for better concurrency. Both patterns work.
